title: Availability updates immediately when rent record is created
gherkin:
Feature: Immediate Availability Synchronization - Rent Creation

Scenario: Item becomes unavailable immediately upon rent creation
  Given an item is available for rental
  When a rent record is created for that item with status 'Approved'
  Then the item's availability status is updated immediately
  And subsequent availability queries reflect the item as unavailable for the rent period
  And no delay is observed between rent creation and availability update
rationale: Validates that availability changes are applied immediately when rent records are created, ensuring real-time synchronization as specified in the operative context.
usedContextItems: The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.|The system shall ensure availability queries reflect the latest rent and item status information.
